summary: TJGC Group Limited, a Nasdaq-listed Hong Kong advertiser now trading as TJGC, filed a 6-K disclosing an Appointment, Business Transformation and Equity Incentive Agreement dated September 16, 2026 with Mr. Kalvin Kwok. Kwok becomes executive director of wholly-owned subsidiary Tongjiang Group Limited to lead entry into AI hardware component sourcing, trading and assembly (DRAM, SSDs, CPUs, ICs). For nil consideration the Company will transfer 49% of Tongjiang's equity to Kwok, non-voting, dividend-only, vesting upon the first binding purchase order; after three months the board may lend or invest for equipment. Watch execution risk and dilution of subsidiary economics.
